files.description: Main EHI export documentation page (b)(10). Describes CDA-format clinical data export and document repository export. This is the core deliverable — a single page with ~200 words of export documentation.
Full-page screenshot of the EHI export documentation page showing all visible content.
Data import specification for patient demographics — 30 fields including MRN, name, DOB, SSN, address, phone, gender, primary/secondary insurance info. Documents the patient data model.
Data import specification for insurance payer directory — 6 fields for payer name and billing address. Documents the insurance payer data model.
Data import specification for CPT/HCPCS codes and fee schedules — 2 fields (code and amount). Documents the billing code data model.
Data import specification for service locations — 10 fields including name, address, NPI, Medicare place of service, CLIA number. Documents the facility data model.
Data import specification for referring physicians — 3 fields (name, NPI). Documents the referring provider data model.
Data import specification for appointments — 6 fields including patient ID, appointment type, reason, resource/provider, date, comments. Documents the scheduling data model.

Data import specification for document uploads — 12 fields including patient ID, document date, name, category, sub-category, and file content (base64 or file path). Documents the document management data model.
Data import specification for problem lists — 5 fields including patient ID, ICD-10-CM code, diagnosis date, active status, provider ID. Documents the diagnosis/condition data model.

Data import specification for allergies and intolerances — 11 fields including patient ID, substance (with RxNorm), reaction (with SNOMED CT), severity, dates. Documents the allergy data model with standard code mappings.
Immunization records import page — exists in sidebar but contains no content (empty page). No field specifications available.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses all downloaded HTML pages and extracts structured data models (field specifications, export descriptions) into queryable JSON.

Extracted data models from 9 import specification pages: 85 total fields across patient demographics (30), insurance (6), CPT/fees (2), service locations (10), referring physicians (3), appointments (6), document uploads (12), problem lists (5), allergies (11).
Structured extraction of the EHI export page content: export format (CDA + document repository), single-patient and population export workflows, document repository organization.
Enrichment accounting: 11 files discovered, 11 parsed, 0 failures, 9 models extracted, 85 fields extracted.
Enrichment README with run commands, input/output boundaries, and known parsing limitations.
